title: Evaluation
tagline: Benchmarks, contamination, human and model judges, capability evaluations and the statistics of evaluation
summary: Knowing what a model can do is surprisingly hard. This course covers benchmark evaluation and its pitfalls of contamination and saturation, human preference evaluation and arenas, models as judges, capability and dangerous-capability evaluations, robustness and calibration, and the statistics needed to compare models honestly.

overview: LLM evaluation measures capability across tasks and benchmarks. This course covers benchmark design, contamination, saturation, and LLM-as-judge methods.
The key insight is that static benchmarks saturate and contamination creeps in. LLM-as-judge methods offer scalable evaluation but have their own biases.
outcomes: Describe benchmark evaluation and its pitfalls.
Implement contamination detection and saturation analysis.
Compare LLM-as-judge and human evaluation methods.
Analyze benchmark design and statistical validity.
